_comment: Literal strings that may stay out of t(), keyed by file path relative to the repo root.
'*' allows a string anywhere. Everything else the scanner finds is a translation bug:
text written straight into the code never changes when the reader changes language.
Add an entry only for text that genuinely has no language - a brand name, a technical
identifier - or for the web export's static metadata, which is not part of the in-app UI.
